reference.generator: Codex built-in image_gen (codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.17.2, gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning medium); the user-supplied style image was attached as a style reference only

styleImage.note: user-supplied in chat (450x315); kept in the git-ignored production folder only

reference.chosen: b (two round buns with bone hairpins, green eyes, sheepskin collar, long-sleeved hide tunic with a red-ochre zigzag hem, shell-and-tooth necklace, ochre cheek stripes, fur leg warmers)
reference.notRecommended: a (a feather with painted face stripes could read as a Native American motif)

referenceMatte.method: BiRefNet cutout of the TRELLIS preparation moved onto the reference (offset 278,33 px, NCC 0.997)

trellis.settings: local TRELLIS-2 C++ GGUF, res 1024, tex 1024, BiRefNet matte, xatlas atlas 2048

other.note: original reference, seed 42: eye recesses and lash ridges, the ochre cheek stripes carved as red slashes
original reference, seed 123: cleaner eyes, no cheek slashes, still 2-3 cm eye recesses
blank face, seed 42: queued as an alternative; not used

blankFace.reason: TRELLIS-2 carved the painted anime eyes of the reference into recesses 2-3 cm deep with lash ridges (dense meshes ref5b seed 42 and 123); cutting or pressing them out of the dense mesh left folded triangles (see rejectedFaceRepairs). A copy of the reference whose eyes, cheek stripes, mouth and nose are filled with the surrounding skin colour reconstructs a smooth featureless face; the painted face of the original reference is projected afterwards.

rejectedFaceRepairs.script: scripts/remake/face_plate.py (kept with its records; the blank-face reference replaced it)
attempts: plate r01-r05 (dense seed 42 and 123): thin-plate-spline face fit and z-only press; eye recess rims and lashes stayed (move limits, per-vertex facing), then folded undercut walls
face7000 r01: the reduced head from the pressed dense mesh had inverted triangles; the projected face became a mosaic of unprojected triangles
untangle (Tutte steps over the feature ellipses): hidden interior layers made it worse (7,673 inverted triangles)
plate r07 (cut out the features and refill with ring caps): the TRELLIS dense mesh has about 2,000 non-manifold edges; the holes split into 7 loops with overlapping caps

meshopt.settings: budget 7000, error .01, MESHOPT_BOOST=y:0.1161:1.6 (the head above the neck keeps more triangles)

reduction.split: faces with centroid y >= 0.1161 (dense units; 0.893 m placed, between the hair tips and the collar) form the head

head.faceTexels: xatlas_unwrap.py --boost-box=-0.1454:0.1452:0.1209:0.3077:0.0634:0.2848:1.8 (the face front: 31% of the head atlas, 1.8x the texel density)

colour.reason: the TRELLIS albedo was darker and more saturated than the reference (hair luminance about half, tunic 25% darker)

body.settings: CIELAB quantile matching of every covered texel to the reference subject pixels in rows 590-1480

head.settings: hair class only (hue <35 or >345, saturation >0.4, value 0.06-0.75): CIELAB mean and spread moved onto the reference hair in rows 30-590

face.settings: replace mode, ellipse 1.339/1.386/-0.171/0.2 from the eye and chin rows 445/572, facing 0.05-0.3, hair guard except in the eye ellipses 417,440,72,64 and 606,440,72,64 and except dark regions thinner than 9 texels, skin tone matched halfway to the reconstruction (--tone-match --tone-strength 0.5), no optical flow (the blank face has no features to align to), registration 986.984 px/m at (508.875, 1467.994), output 1024, WebP q92

skinMaterial.reason: the hands have the colour of the cream fur (hue 30, saturation 0.29 against 0.22-0.28): the clothing dye, which classifies colours, cannot dye the cuffs and keep the hands; the bare skin (hands beyond the cuffs, most of the legs between the warmers and the hem, the front of the neck: 118 faces) is a second material with the same textures, which the dye rule does not name
rejected: r01/r02: one texture sample per face missed long faces running from the skin into the fur

rejected.r01 (second try): the chunky boots stayed on the shin bones: no sole vertex for the locomotion builder, NaN hips in Walk_Loop/Run_Loop (rigid feet added)
rejected.r02: the textures before the colour matching and the skin material
rejected.r03: the hand weights peaked at 0.53-0.6 (shared with the forearm): src/torch-grasp.ts found no hand vertex above 0.65 and the torch grip became NaN (rigid hands added)
